bull.b: Positive Phase 1 biomarker and safety results provide initial human validation for Axiomer RNA editing. This may improve confidence in the platform, support advancement of AX-0811 and strengthen ProQR’s ability to attract partners.

bull.t: Revenue rebound and high gross margins

bear.b: ProQR remains materially distant from break-even despite revenue growth. Persistent operating losses could consume equity and increase dependence on future financing, limiting strategic flexibility until clinical programs generate milestones or commercial revenue.
